core_services.short_description: High-capacity global A2P and P2P SMS termination over Tier-1 direct SS7/SIGTRAN and SMPP carrier interconnects.
core_services.detailed_overview: Kimosha Telecom operates direct bilateral routing agreements with 500+ mobile network operators (MNOs) worldwide. Our least-cost routing (LCR) engine dynamically selects optimized delivery paths based on real-time delivery rates, latency thresholds, and route quality scores.
key_features: Direct SS7/SIGTRAN and SMPP 3.4 connectivity
Dynamic Least Cost Routing (LCR) with quality-first fallback
Real-time handset Delivery Receipts (DLR) with error code mapping
Unicode, concatenated long messages (UDH), and GSM 03.38 alphabet support
Dynamic Sender ID registration and alpha-tag management
Adaptive throttling and burst traffic buffering up to 15,000 TPS

route_types.description: Direct interconnects with MNO SMSCs ensuring 100% handset DLRs and guaranteed CLI/Alphanumeric sender preservation.
Optimized cost-effective paths for marketing blasts and non-time-sensitive notifications.

core_services.short_description: Crystal-clear global voice termination with guaranteed CLI pass-through, low Post-Dial Delay (PDD), and Tier-1 interconnects.
core_services.detailed_overview: Carrier-grade SIP trunking infrastructure supporting G.711 (alaw/ulaw), G.729, and Opus codecs. Our geographically distributed Session Border Controllers (SBCs) in Frankfurt, Dubai, London, and Singapore guarantee sub-50ms jitter and high Answer-Seizure-Ratios (ASR).
key_features: Guaranteed True CLI (Calling Line Identification) route pass-through
Support for SIP (RFC 3261), TLS, and SRTP secure voice transport
Low Post-Dial Delay (PDD < 1.5s) and high Average Call Duration (ACD)
Automated fraud mitigation, FAS (False Answer Supervision) detection
Dedicated interconnects: SIP IP auth or Digest Authentication
Comprehensive CDR (Call Detail Record) extraction via API or SFTP

core_services.short_description: Mission-critical, ultra-low latency transactional messaging for OTPs, two-factor authentication (2FA), banking alerts, and system notices.
core_services.detailed_overview: Engineered for zero-drop performance. Transactional messages bypass standard marketing queues through dedicated priority lanes, ensuring verification codes reach end-users in under 2 seconds globally.
key_features: Priority queue processing with < 1.2s global delivery
Built-in Number Lookup (HLR/MNP) for carrier validation and ported numbers
Adaptive routing that automatically re-routes OTPs on MNO congestion
End-to-end TLS 1.3 encryption and full GDPR/HIPAA compliance
Webhooks for instant delivery receipts and read confirmations
Smart retry logic with channel fallback

core_services.short_description: Developer-friendly communication APIs and robust high-throughput SMPP 3.4 binds for effortless enterprise integration.
core_services.detailed_overview: Connect via binary SMPP 3.4 protocols for maximum raw throughput or use modern RESTful JSON APIs with comprehensive SDKs in Python, Node.js, PHP, Java, and Go.
key_features: SMPP 3.4 Transceiver, Transmitter, and Receiver bind support
REST API with JSON payloads, OpenAPI 3.0 specs, and Postman collections
Real-time bidirectional Webhooks for status reports and inbound MO SMS
Granular IP whitelisting, API keys, and OAuth2 security
Comprehensive sandbox test environment with simulated carrier responses
Detailed developer documentation and live request debugger

core_services.short_description: Single-point-of-contact hubbing connecting mobile operators, Tier-1 aggregators, and enterprise clients to over 800 networks.
core_services.detailed_overview: Eliminate the administrative and technical overhead of maintaining hundreds of individual bilateral agreements. Kimosha's SMS Hub aggregates traffic flows, performs real-time monetization, and protects against grey route leakage and SMS fraud.
key_features: Single commercial agreement for worldwide 800+ mobile network reach
Automated Least Cost Routing with dynamic quality grading
Integrated firewall and spam filtering protecting MNO networks
Bilateral and unilateral interconnect settlements
Multi-currency billing (USD, EUR, GBP, AED)
Real-time traffic analytics and QoS dashboard

core_services.short_description: High-volume automated outbound voice broadcast campaigns with multi-level interactive DTMF menus and speech synthesis.
core_services.detailed_overview: Broadcast emergency notifications, debt collection reminders, or customer satisfaction surveys to tens of thousands of recipients simultaneously with smart call sequencing and live agent transfer.
key_features: Concurrent outbound calling handling 10,000+ simultaneous channels
Dynamic Text-to-Speech (TTS) in 40+ languages and accents
Pre-recorded audio upload with WAV/MP3 conversion
Interactive DTMF key-press menu captures and webhook integration
Answering Machine Detection (AMD) to optimize message delivery
Warm transfer to live agent or external call queues

network_infrastructure.redundancy: Active-Active geo-redundant cluster architecture with automatic failover (<50ms)
network_infrastructure.connectivity: Direct cross-connects to Tier-1 IP transit providers and carrier IXPs

smpp_specifications.throughput_per_bind: Up to 500 TPS per TCP session (multi-bind supported)
